# Throughline

> A lightweight, embeddable, framework-agnostic durable-execution library for AI agents.
> Wrap any agent loop and get crash-safe step checkpointing, automatic resume,
> exactly-once side effects via idempotency keys, durable human-in-the-loop pauses,
> deterministic record/replay testing, and token/cost budgets. SQLite locally, Postgres
> in production, bring-your-own-LLM. npm scope: @through-line.

Key facts: only `ctx.step` bodies are durable; delivery is at-least-once and side
effects are exactly-once iff idempotency-keyed; runs park durably on
`ctx.waitForApproval` / `ctx.waitForEvent`; a dev-mode determinism guard throws
`NonDeterminismError` when a replay diverges from the journal.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): purpose, quickstart, package table, CLI and MCP setup
- [Durability guarantees](docs/guarantees.md): the contract of record - replay
  algorithm, lease fencing, budgets, cancellation, migrations, error taxonomy
- [MCP server](docs/mcp.md): operating runs from Claude or any MCP host
- [Recipe: wrap your loop](docs/recipes/wrap-your-loop.md): make an existing agent durable
- [Recipe: human approval](docs/recipes/human-approval.md): durable sign-off gates
- [Recipe: record/replay testing](docs/recipes/record-replay-testing.md): golden traces
- [Recipe: budgets](docs/recipes/budgets.md): token limits that survive crashes
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): build, test, changesets, the BYO-LLM rule
